ai_review.summary: Good‑quality recording of a solid 1989 show highlighted by Let the Good Times Roll, Built to Last material and a rare Foolish Heart encore.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this performance four stars, noting that the band is in top form with an excellent mix of classic standards and newer songs such as Let the Good Times Roll and Built to Last. The recording is generally pleasant – the Dead’s tone comes through clearly despite a few odd noises – and it even captures a rare Foolish Heart encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlighting strong musical performance and only minor oddities in the audio give a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tone is clear and pleasant; reviewers mention a few strange sounds but no major dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A balanced blend of old standards and newer breakout material, showing the band hitting their stride in 1989.
